messages:
matt_sales: heads-up — new enterprise POC (healthcare) asking for 45% off hosted API + 6mo commit. need deal desk path and SF/CPQ fields to capture this. any blockers?
sana_revenueops: 45% is above standard discount bands, def needs deal desk + legal review. is this Dedicated or Hosted?
matt_sales: hosted API for now, might convert to Dedicated later if throughput picks up.
leo_dealdesk: tagging the inputs we need: Opportunity record should include Deal_Type__c (POC/Prod), Commit_Tier__c (0/3/6/12), Requested_Discount__c (percent), Special_Terms_Flag__c (boolean), and Security_Questionnaire__c (link).
anya_eng: security questionnaire is already flagged — they requested a SOC2 summary and an MSA tweak. engineering note: POC will use synthetic data, but they want DPA language in MSA.
tara_legal: DPA + minimal MSA tweaks. if discount >40% AND commit <12mo => legal approval required. we also need to review indemnity/security clauses.
matt_sales: what's the approval route in SF for this combo? can we automate routing?
sana_revenueops: propose routing flow: first pass -> leo_dealdesk (auto if discount >25%), second -> tara_legal (auto if >40% or Special_Terms_Flag__c=true), final -> CRO (only if >50% or non-standard refund/credit terms). SLA: 8 business hours for first pass (deal desk), 24 business hours for legal.
leo_dealdesk: agree. we'll add an Approval_Path__c picklist that resolves to ["DealDesk","Legal","CRO"]. CPQ rule: apply "EscalateToLegal" when Requested_Discount__c >= 40 OR Special_Terms_Flag__c = true or Commit_Tier__c < 12 with revenue risk.
matt_sales: can you paste the CPQ rule snippet we can attach to the opportunity?
leo_dealdesk: sure — sample logic (pseudo):
```
IF Requested_Discount__c >= 40 THEN Approval_Path__c = 'Legal'
ELSE IF Requested_Discount__c >= 25 THEN Approval_Path__c = 'DealDesk'
ELSE Approval_Path__c = 'AutoApproved'
IF Special_Terms_Flag__c = TRUE THEN Approval_Path__c = 'Legal'
```

sana_revenueops: also add a field: Approval_SLA_Target__c to surface expected turnaround (8h/24h/48h) on the opp page. That helps AE manage expectations with customer.
anya_eng: operational note — if this becomes Dedicated later, the discount calculus changes (commits invert pricing). mark Transition_Risk__c = 'High' so deal desk can require capacity commit review.
tara_legal: for the legal review, attach these docs to the SF case: Security_Questionnaire__c, Proposed_MSA_Changes__c, and the proposed pricing exhibit. we will respond within 24 business hours unless external counsel needed.
matt_sales: i've created the opp and added the fields above. URL: https://redwood.salesforce.com/opp/00Q1x0000XXXXXX — please take a look.
leo_dealdesk: looked. set Approval_Path__c = 'Legal' and added deal desk note: "45% for POC — recommend cap to 40 + pilot discount table. ask AE to request customer commit for 12mo to avoid escalation."
sana_revenueops: I'm creating an automated case creation rule: when Approval_Path__c changes to 'Legal' create case in DEALDESK queue and notify #deal-desk Slack channel via deploy-bot. SLA countdown begins on case creation.
deploy-bot: case CREATED: DD-2026-1987 assigned to leo_dealdesk. SLA target: 24 business hours.
leo_dealdesk: i'll run the initial pricing model and suggest 40% pilot rate + optional conversion credit. if customer insists on 45, we'll need CRO signoff and revenue ops mitigation plan.
tara_legal: quick reminder: if they request MSA signature before PO, require a short form DPA addendum (we have a template). attaching template to case.
matt_sales: thanks. one more thing — security wants to run a short internal red-team check before prod. is that a blocker for POC?
anya_eng: not for POC using synthetic data. for prod we'll require SOC2 evidence. mark Security_Gate__c = 'POC_Clear' for now.
sana_revenueops: next steps: (1) deal desk to propose final pilot pricing within 8 business hours, (2) legal to review MSA/DPA within 24 business hours, (3) revenue ops to lock CPQ approval routing and SLA fields by EOD.
leo_dealdesk: ack — will post pricing recommendation in this thread.
matt_sales: appreciated. i'll message the customer that we are escalating and give the SLA commitments. :thumbsup:
